description: A warm Phaser pet-care and potion-brewing game with illustrated pets, care tools, nursery paths, balanced stats, ingredient collection, evolution, and a complete free local brew-and-save loop. New wallet-funded runs remain gated until the deployed reward pool and full Morpheus settlement path have production evidence; historical recovery stays available in the runtime.
description_zh: 温暖明亮的 Phaser 宠物照料与药水炼制游戏，拥有插画宠物、照护道具、育成路线、状态平衡、材料收集、进化，以及完整的免费本地炼制与保存循环。新的钱包付费对局将在已部署奖励池和完整 Morpheus 结算路径获得生产证据后开放；历史对局恢复能力仍保留在运行时中。
name: Pet Potion

operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a nursery path, care for the pet, collect one essence from every tool, brew the potion, and save the local result. Free play never opens a wallet prompt or writes to chain.
operation_panel.title: Pet Potion

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Free local play makes no oracle request. The historical recovery implementation remains available, while new paid runs stay gated until a funded end-to-end settlement has production evidence.

tee.description: Free local play makes no TEE request. Morpheus-backed paid starts are not advertised until live pool and settlement validation is complete.
